author: Matt Wolfe
description:
No WiFi? No problem. 

Here is how I’m running advanced AI models like Qwen 3.5 directly on my phone without any internet connection. It’s an app called Locally AI.

This is NOT sponsored, just sharing a cool AI tool I came across. I see this as a great way to still get support from AI while you're somewhere without internet, like on a plane or in a remote location. 

It’s FREE and 100% private. None of your data gets sent to the cloud or to any AI company to use for training.

I go over all the details, including the link to download it, more pros and cons, and more examples in my full YouTube video linked here.
